name: amm
description: An AMM over Mandala tokens, the Open Exchange (docs/AMM.md): the overlay engine (shruggr/skein-overlay 0.12.1, required: chain/1) with the Mandala components (shruggr/skein-mandala 0.9.2: the topic manager mandala-topic, one topic per token tm_mandala_<assetId> (BRC-207: tm_mandala_<txid>_0, tm_mandala_<txid>_<vout>) and the discovery topic tm_mandala; the lookups ls_mandala, ls_mandala_deploys and each token's ls_mandala_<assetId>, one index; the token list, the read route /mandala/tokens of mandala-lookup), the pool lookup ls_amm (amm-lookup, one service over every token topic, each query naming its token: a pool is listed only while its contract output and its deploy's claim are unspent and the claim verifies; registered by root beside its declaration, it beats on ls_amm-live, per token, this skein's per-validator totals of its listed pools: the prices), the validator (amm-validator: swap and deploy as libp2p direct calls; the deploy delivered, every input SIGHASH_SINGLE over its own output and one token unit left, checked against the validator's terms, config.amm.ammValidator {lpFeeBps, validatorFeeBps, commissionBps}, and claimed: one unit P2PKH to the pool's validator key, its payload that key's signature over the pool's script and the first token input; it submits to its own overlay by message, {fn: "submit"} in the box submit (<app>/submit), files the claim in the instance's wallet, and rescinds a listing on root's {fn: "rescind", args: {pool}} in the box validator (<app>/validator) by spending the claim as the wallet's caller input) and amm-p2p: the marketplace relay (its box <app>/amm-p2p and the route /call; amm.swap/1, amm.pool/1 with terms: a taker's or an LP's transaction carried to the validator the caller names by identity key and libp2p peer ID, dialled, or handed in-VM to this instance's own amm-validator when that peer is this node), the holders' listing requests (box <app>/requests, anyone; the read route /requests), the chain state of an outpoint (the read route /spends), and the pages, www/ served from the app's own tree by the read route / (its filter page, amm-p2p's serve; at the origin root by root's route to the same filter). The contract is Swap (the validator's) and Close (the LP's: everything out, bsvFee left for the miner). Anyone submits to the engine by message in the box submit, answered by message, or by POST /submit, BRC-22: it waits and answers the STEAK. The manifest declares no topics: root registers each token with the engine in the box register (<app>/register; roles: {root: [register, registerLookup, deregisterLookup, rescind]}): {fn: "register", args: {topic: "tm_mandala_<assetId>", program: "mandala-topic"}}, {fn: "registerLookup", args: {service: "ls_mandala_<assetId>", program: "mandala-lookup", topics: ["tm_mandala_<assetId>"]}} and {fn: "registerLookup", args: {service: "ls_amm", program: "amm-lookup"}}; deregisterLookup then deregister drop it. Every skein is a market and a validator, always (skein-overlay 0.12): a register asks liveness of and beacons the topic's tm_mandala_<txid>_0-live (config.overlay.market {window} / .validator {every}, else 40 000 / 30 000 ms; this manifest sets neither).
